title: General Material Blend 4-Mix Duo #02 (부채꼴·물결 / 대각 띠·매끈 | 뱀비늘+금박+공작눈무늬+목재 / 목재+뱀비늘+스테인드글라스+흑요암금)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Iranian, in her early 30s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing two to three pieces of mixed-metal a necklace. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 46% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 12 o'clock, 3 o'clock, 6 o'clock and 10 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 3 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the wedge between the 3 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied ELECTRIC CRIMSON leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 3 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC TEAL-GOLD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP VIOLET radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 4 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries pale golden oak wood fused directly into her own form, natural straight grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING warm honey-blonde grain with VIVID amber highlight streaks. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera, her extreme platform lace-up sandals, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Pakistani, in her early 30s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in elegant updo, real pores, real living eyes, 200 clicker rings piercings set with sapphires in silver-toned metal, wearing a single piece of mixed-metal a bracelet. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 27% of the way down her figure from the top, about 48% of the way down her figure from the top and about 74% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries deep black ebony wood fused directly into her own form, natural fine grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING glossy jet-black grain with VIVID dark-brown highlight streaks. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING WARM BRONZE scale formations, VIVID BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
